entries.en: The missing photograph resurfaced inside a box of old postcards.
entries.zh: 那张失踪的照片在一盒旧明信片里重新出现了。

entries.en: We spent a carefree afternoon flying kites beside the river.
entries.zh: 我们在河边放风筝，度过了一个无忧无虑的下午。

entries.en: He trundled a cart of library books along the corridor.
entries.zh: 他沿着走廊慢慢推着一车图书馆的书。

entries.meaningZh: 难以形容的（尤指极坏的事物）
entries.en: The memoir describes the unspeakable suffering caused by the war.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录描写了战争造成的难以形容的苦难。

entries.en: A libertarian joined the panel discussing personal freedom and government power.
entries.zh: 一位自由意志主义者参加了讨论个人自由与政府权力的座谈会。

entries.en: Indiscriminate pruning had removed both healthy and damaged branches.
entries.zh: 不加区分的修剪把健康和受损的树枝都剪掉了。

entries.en: A cardboard dragon served as the school orchestra's mascot.
entries.zh: 一条纸板龙成了学校管弦乐团的吉祥物。

entries.en: The sauce was still lumpy despite several minutes of stirring.
entries.zh: 虽然搅拌了几分钟，酱汁里仍有结块。

entries.en: The walkers regrouped beside the bridge before continuing uphill.
entries.zh: 徒步者们在桥边重新集合，然后继续上山。

entries.en: A boyish grin appeared when he discovered the model railway.
entries.zh: 发现那套铁路模型时，他露出了男孩般的笑容。

entries.en: Her patient explanations were sorely missed after she left the team.
entries.zh: 她离开团队后，大家十分怀念她耐心的讲解。

entries.en: The soprano held the final note above the quiet orchestra.
entries.zh: 在乐队轻柔的伴奏中，女高音歌手延长了最后一个音。

entries.en: He dismissed the petty quarrel as unworthy of further attention.
entries.zh: 他认为这场琐碎争吵不值得再关注，便不予理会。

entries.en: The patient caretaker seemed to personify the spirit of the village.
entries.zh: 那位耐心的管理员似乎体现了村庄的精神。

entries.en: She gave me an incredulous look when I mentioned the ticket price.
entries.zh: 我提到票价时，她难以置信地看了我一眼。

entries.en: Jasmine climbed the courtyard wall and scented the evening air.
entries.zh: 茉莉爬上了庭院的墙，晚风中飘着花香。

entries.en: A baritone sang the traveller's farewell in the opera's second act.
entries.zh: 一位男中音歌手在歌剧第二幕演唱了旅人的告别曲。

entries.en: They returned to the village whence their long journey had begun.
entries.zh: 他们回到了那场漫长旅程的出发村庄。

entries.en: The historical novel condemns the prison's inhuman treatment of captives.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说谴责了监狱对俘虏的残忍待遇。

entries.en: Her godfather sent a handwritten letter on her eighteenth birthday.
entries.zh: 她十八岁生日时，教父寄来了一封手写信。

entries.en: The hapless messenger arrived just after the last boat departed.
entries.zh: 那个倒霉的信使到达时，末班船刚刚离开。

entries.en: His misplaced enthusiasm for jokes irritated the exhausted rehearsal crew.
entries.zh: 排练人员已经筋疲力尽，他不合时宜地热衷讲笑话，让大家很恼火。

entries.en: The menu offered tiny pancakes topped with a spoonful of caviar.
entries.zh: 菜单上有配一勺鱼子酱的小薄饼。

entries.en: She swathed the fragile sculpture in layers of soft cloth.
entries.zh: 她用多层软布裹住了那件易碎的雕塑。

entries.en: The café's retro lamps matched its collection of old radios.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆的复古灯具与收藏的旧收音机十分相配。

entries.en: The chef sliced the roasted pork loin before serving dinner.
entries.zh: 厨师在上晚餐前把烤猪腰肉切成了片。

entries.en: The naval exhibit compares the firepower of two historic warships.
entries.zh: 海军展览比较了两艘历史战舰的火力。

entries.en: The biography follows the pilot's return to civilian work in peacetime.
entries.zh: 这部传记讲述了那位飞行员在和平时期重返平民工作的经历。

entries.en: The unbalanced display placed every large painting on one wall.
entries.zh: 这次陈列很不均衡，把所有大画都放在了一面墙上。

entries.en: The classroom's periodic table marked phosphorus with the symbol P.
entries.zh: 教室里的元素周期表用符号P标示磷。

entries.en: The observatory's evening lecture featured an image of a distant quasar.
entries.zh: 天文台的晚间讲座展示了一张遥远类星体的图像。

entries.en: We crossed the empty square in the searing afternoon heat.
entries.zh: 我们顶着午后灼热的暑气穿过空旷的广场。

entries.en: The old camera's diaphragm controlled how much light reached the film.
entries.zh: 那台旧相机的光圈装置控制着到达胶片的光量。

entries.en: The cat remained unconcerned as rain battered the window.
entries.zh: 雨猛烈地打着窗户，那只猫仍然毫不担心。

entries.en: Small terraces cut green stripes across the steep mountainside.
entries.zh: 一小块一小块的梯田在陡峭山坡上划出一道道绿色条纹。

entries.en: The anatomy model had one removable vertebra near its base.
entries.zh: 那个解剖模型靠近底部的地方有一块可拆卸的椎骨。

entries.en: The singer conveyed heartbreak without raising her voice above a whisper.
entries.zh: 歌手以近乎耳语的声音表达了心碎之情。

entries.en: The balcony offered an uninterrupted view across the marshes.
entries.zh: 从阳台望去，沼泽地的景色一览无余。

entries.en: She paired a sporty jacket with her oldest walking boots.
entries.zh: 她把一件运动风格的夹克与那双最旧的徒步靴搭配起来。

entries.en: Vociferous supporters greeted the winning team outside the station.
entries.zh: 大声欢呼的支持者们在车站外迎接获胜的球队。

entries.en: The sleepy pussy curled beside the hearth in the old illustration.
entries.zh: 那幅旧插画里，困倦的猫咪蜷卧在炉边。

entries.en: A thin layer of caramel covered the chilled dessert.
entries.zh: 那份冷藏甜点上覆着薄薄一层焦糖。

entries.en: The novel's squatter lives quietly in an abandoned railway cottage.
entries.zh: 小说里的擅自占屋者悄悄住在一间废弃的铁路小屋里。

entries.en: Several shops jumped on the bandwagon when handmade soap became fashionable.
entries.zh: 手工皂流行起来后，几家商店也跟着赶起了潮流。

entries.en: The course gave apprentices a solid grounding in furniture design.
entries.zh: 这门课程让学徒们接受了扎实的家具设计基础训练。

entries.en: She expressed her displeasure at finding paint on the piano.
entries.zh: 发现钢琴上沾了颜料，她表示了不满。

entries.en: A shaggy dog waited patiently outside the village bakery.
entries.zh: 一只毛发蓬乱的狗耐心地等在村里面包店外。

entries.en: The exhibition examines public opposition to the ruler's barbaric punishments.
entries.zh: 展览考察了公众对那位统治者野蛮刑罚的反对。

entries.en: Months of inaction allowed the small leak to damage the ceiling.
entries.zh: 几个月都没有处理，小漏水最终损坏了天花板。

entries.en: The designer removed the tacky plastic jewels from the costume.
entries.zh: 设计师把戏服上那些俗气的塑料珠宝摘了下来。

entries.en: We chose an uncomplicated melody that everyone could sing together.
entries.zh: 我们选了一首人人都能一起唱的简单旋律。

entries.en: The bottom drawer held miscellaneous buttons, ribbons, and broken pencils.
entries.zh: 最下面的抽屉里装着各式纽扣、丝带和断铅笔。

entries.en: A tiny vortex formed as the bathwater drained away.
entries.zh: 浴缸里的水排走时，形成了一个小漩涡。

entries.en: The ancient bus wheezed up the hill behind a tractor.
entries.zh: 那辆老旧的公交车跟在拖拉机后面，呼哧作响地爬上山坡。

entries.en: His dishonesty about the missing tools damaged the group's trust.
entries.zh: 他对工具失踪一事不诚实，损害了小组对他的信任。

entries.en: A sense of disquiet spread when the radio fell silent.
entries.zh: 收音机突然没了声音，一种不安感蔓延开来。

entries.en: The new shelving quadrupled the archive's storage capacity.
entries.zh: 新装的搁架使档案馆的存储容量增至四倍。

entries.en: Their letters describe the unexpected joys and challenges of parenthood.
entries.zh: 他们的书信描写了为人父母带来的意外喜悦与挑战。

entries.en: After a sleepless night, he welcomed the quiet morning train.
entries.zh: 一夜未眠之后，他很庆幸早班火车里十分安静。

entries.en: A sickening smell drifted from the forgotten bin behind the shed.
entries.zh: 棚屋后被遗忘的垃圾桶飘出一股令人作呕的气味。

entries.en: The reclaimed wood made attractive flooring for the new studio.
entries.zh: 回收的木材成了新工作室里美观的地板材料。

entries.en: The archivists cleared a backlog of letters awaiting classification.
entries.zh: 档案工作人员清理了积压的待分类信件。

entries.en: The festival ended in an orgy of colour and music.
entries.zh: 节庆在色彩与音乐的狂欢中结束了。

entries.en: Mud splattered the lower windows as the truck passed.
entries.zh: 卡车经过时，泥浆溅上了较低的窗户。

entries.en: The path through the pasture was dotted with cattle dung.
entries.zh: 穿过牧场的小路上散落着牛粪。

entries.en: The frame's colour was immaterial to the question of authenticity.
entries.zh: 画框的颜色与真伪问题无关。

entries.en: The collector bought the drawing for an undisclosed sum.
entries.zh: 那位收藏家以未公开的价格买下了这幅素描。

entries.en: The comedy mocks the upper echelons of the fictional academy.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧嘲讽了那所虚构学院的上层人物。

entries.en: Their commendable patience kept the complicated rehearsal running smoothly.
entries.zh: 他们值得称赞的耐心使复杂的排练顺利进行。

entries.en: Logistic problems delayed the delivery of scenery to the island theatre.
entries.zh: 后勤问题延误了布景运往海岛剧院的时间。

entries.en: She zapped the cold soup in the microwave before lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭前，她用微波炉热了凉汤。

entries.en: An inflatable whale floated above the crowded festival entrance.
entries.zh: 一条充气鲸鱼漂浮在拥挤的节庆入口上方。

entries.en: A cheery message from my sister brightened the rainy morning.
entries.zh: 姐姐发来的一条欢快消息让这个雨天早晨明亮了起来。

entries.en: The history course compares federalism with more centralized political systems.
entries.zh: 历史课比较了联邦制与权力更集中的政治制度。

entries.en: The museum traces the territory's long campaign for statehood.
entries.zh: 博物馆追溯了那片领地争取成为州的漫长历程。

entries.en: The suitcase was ridiculously heavy for a two-day visit.
entries.zh: 只去两天，那只行李箱却重得离谱。

entries.en: A gull perched on the ship's starboard railing.
entries.zh: 一只海鸥栖在船的右舷栏杆上。

entries.en: The historical drama follows a captain struggling to prevent a mutiny.
entries.zh: 这部历史剧讲述了一位船长竭力阻止兵变的故事。

entries.en: The cast finished a gruelling week of rehearsals before opening night.
entries.zh: 首演之夜到来之前，演员们结束了令人筋疲力尽的一周排练。

entries.en: The childless couple welcomed their nieces for the summer holidays.
entries.zh: 那对没有子女的夫妇欢迎侄女们来过暑假。

entries.en: After the venue closed, the question of seating became moot.
entries.zh: 场馆关闭以后，座位安排的问题就失去了实际意义。

entries.en: A profusion of wildflowers covered the slope behind the cottage.
entries.zh: 小屋后面的山坡上开满了野花。

entries.en: She wrapped squares of homemade fudge in little paper parcels.
entries.zh: 她把自制软糖块包成了一个个小纸包。

entries.en: The stage witch stirred an empty cauldron with an enormous spoon.
entries.zh: 舞台上的女巫用一把大勺子搅动着空锅。

entries.en: The exhibition pairs couture with the sketches that inspired each garment.
entries.zh: 展览将高级时装与启发每件服装设计的草图配对展出。

entries.en: The historian examined the province's unsuccessful attempt at secession.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了那个省试图脱离却未成功的事件。

entries.en: He stared in bewilderment at the empty space where his bicycle belonged.
entries.zh: 他困惑地盯着本该停放自行车的那片空地。

entries.en: A gust through the doorway snuffed the candle beside the mirror.
entries.zh: 门口吹来一阵风，熄灭了镜子旁的蜡烛。

entries.en: The countdown began as the performers took their places.
entries.zh: 演员们就位时，倒计时开始了。

entries.en: The greyhound stretched its long legs across the kitchen rug.
entries.zh: 那只灵缇犬在厨房地毯上伸展着长腿。

entries.en: The narrator intoned the ancient prophecy while the stage darkened.
entries.zh: 舞台渐暗时，叙述者以庄重平缓的声调念出了古老的预言。

entries.en: A sleepy tot clutched a toy rabbit on the train.
entries.zh: 火车上，一个困倦的幼儿紧抱着玩具兔。

entries.en: A community garden now occupies the former industrial wasteland.
entries.zh: 一座社区花园如今占据了昔日的工业荒地。

entries.en: Her effortless performance concealed years of careful practice.
entries.zh: 她看似毫不费力的表演背后，是多年的认真练习。

entries.en: The meeting ended in recrimination rather than an agreed plan.
entries.zh: 会议以相互指责告终，没有形成一致的方案。

entries.en: His indecision kept the group waiting outside two nearly identical cafés.
entries.zh: 他犹豫不决，让大家在两家几乎一样的咖啡馆外等着。

entries.en: Her new hairstyle kept her hair clear of the pottery wheel.
entries.zh: 她的新发型使头发不会碰到陶轮。

entries.en: A natural loner, he preferred sketching alone beside the canal.
entries.zh: 他天生喜欢独处，更愿意独自在运河边写生。

entries.en: He left in a huff when nobody admired his elaborate hat.
entries.zh: 没人赞赏他那顶精巧的帽子，他便气呼呼地离开了。

entries.en: We redistributed the chairs so every workshop group had enough seats.
entries.zh: 我们重新分配了椅子，让每个工作坊小组都有足够的座位。

entries.en: The bridal bouquet lay on a chair beside the window.
entries.zh: 新娘的捧花放在窗边的一把椅子上。

entries.en: Her businesslike manner brought the wandering discussion back to the agenda.
entries.zh: 她高效有条理的作风把跑题的讨论拉回了议程。

entries.en: Trailing greenery softened the bare brick wall of the courtyard.
entries.zh: 垂下的绿植使庭院光秃秃的砖墙显得柔和起来。

entries.en: The wobbly table rattled whenever someone leaned on its edge.
entries.zh: 那张桌子摇晃不稳，谁一靠桌边就会发出响声。

entries.en: A pale grub curled beneath the rotten piece of bark.
entries.zh: 一条浅色幼虫蜷缩在腐烂的树皮下面。

entries.en: The bass notes throbbed through the floor of the rehearsal room.
entries.zh: 低音音符有节奏地震动着排练室的地板。

entries.en: Climbing plants concealed the unsightly concrete wall behind the café.
entries.zh: 攀缘植物遮住了咖啡馆后面那堵难看的水泥墙。

entries.en: Mercifully, the rain stopped before the outdoor performance began.
entries.zh: 幸好，露天演出开始前雨停了。

entries.en: The documentary argues that museums often undervalue everyday household objects.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片认为，博物馆往往低估日常家居用品的价值。

entries.en: A tearful farewell followed the choir's final rehearsal together.
entries.zh: 合唱团最后一次共同排练后，大家含泪道别。

entries.en: The annual extravaganza combined puppets, dancers, and a full brass band.
entries.zh: 每年的大型华丽演出把木偶、舞者和一整支铜管乐队融合在一起。

entries.en: The designer turned leftover fabric into marketable bags and purses.
entries.zh: 设计师把剩余布料做成了有销路的包和钱包。

entries.en: The river plunged over a cataract hidden beyond the forest.
entries.zh: 河水从森林后隐藏的一道大瀑布上倾泻而下。

entries.en: Smoke had blackened the stone above the old fireplace.
entries.zh: 烟把旧壁炉上方的石头熏黑了。

entries.en: An upturn in visitor numbers brought new energy to the museum.
entries.zh: 参观人数回升，给博物馆带来了新的活力。

entries.en: After another unprofitable argument, they agreed to try a practical experiment.
entries.zh: 又争论了一次却毫无收获后，他们同意做个实际试验。

entries.en: He puttered around the greenhouse, moving pots and trimming leaves.
entries.zh: 他在温室里慢悠悠地忙着，挪挪花盆，修修叶子。

entries.en: The autocratic director refused to discuss changes with the cast.
entries.zh: 那位专横的导演拒绝与演员讨论修改方案。

entries.en: An opportunistic rival claimed credit for the absent artist's idea.
entries.zh: 一个投机取巧的对手把未到场艺术家的创意据为己功。

entries.en: A hawthorn shaded the narrow gate at the orchard entrance.
entries.zh: 一棵山楂树为果园入口的窄门遮着荫。

entries.en: The newsletter includes a roundup of recent discoveries in the archive.
entries.zh: 这份通讯包含对档案馆近期发现的综述。

entries.en: The library expanded its collection of books on geriatric care.
entries.zh: 图书馆扩充了老年护理方面的藏书。

entries.en: A tireless volunteer repaired every torn costume before the show.
entries.zh: 一位不知疲倦的志愿者在演出前修好了所有破损的戏服。

entries.en: A sharp blip interrupted the otherwise silent recording.
entries.zh: 一声尖短的信号音打断了原本寂静的录音。

entries.en: The disused incinerator appears in photographs of the old factory.
entries.zh: 旧工厂的照片中能看到那座已停用的焚烧炉。

entries.en: The laboratory received a semen sample for analysis.
entries.zh: 实验室收到了一份用于分析的精液样本。

entries.en: An enchanting path wound between the river and the orchard.
entries.zh: 一条迷人的小路蜿蜒在河流与果园之间。

entries.en: The seminar examined patriarchy through the novel's family relationships.
entries.zh: 研讨课通过小说中的家庭关系考察了父权制。

entries.en: His red beret stood out among the grey winter coats.
entries.zh: 他的红色贝雷帽在一片灰色冬衣中十分显眼。

entries.en: A rusted bayonet lay in the military museum's glass case.
entries.zh: 一把生锈的刺刀放在军事博物馆的玻璃柜里。

entries.zh: 一棵高高的杨树在运河水面上映出了倒影。

entries.en: The anatomy chart labels the pelvic bones beneath the spine.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了脊柱下方的骨盆诸骨。

entries.en: She remained the undisputed champion of the village chess tournament.
entries.zh: 她仍然是村庄国际象棋比赛中无可争议的冠军。

entries.en: The manor stands in rolling parkland dotted with ancient trees.
entries.zh: 庄园坐落在起伏的开阔草地中，其间点缀着古树。

entries.en: Her steely gaze silenced the last whispers at the meeting.
entries.zh: 她坚定冷峻的目光让会场最后的低语也停了下来。

entries.en: A horrid smell greeted us when we opened the forgotten cupboard.
entries.zh: 打开那个被遗忘的柜子，一股讨厌的气味扑面而来。

entries.en: The novel follows a child traumatized by the destruction of her home.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一名因家园被毁而受到精神创伤的孩子的经历。

entries.zh: 深色木质墙板使阅览室显得安静庄重。

entries.zh: 那套戏服配有一只长过手腕的刺绣长手套。

entries.zh: 海事展览陈列着一根用大麻纤维制成的绳子。

entries.en: The cottage enjoys an enviable view of the lake and distant hills.
entries.zh: 那间小屋能看到令人羡慕的湖景和远山。

entries.zh: 一只适合搂抱的玩具熊占据了沙发上最好的位置。

entries.zh: 那位年轻滑雪者在平缓的训练坡上练习回转滑雪。

entries.en: The captain wrested a narrow victory from a stronger opponent.
entries.zh: 队长艰难地以微弱优势击败了更强的对手。

entries.en: A little motorboat chugged beneath the bridge at sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出时，一艘小摩托艇突突作响地驶过桥下。

entries.en: The chef shaved a truffle over the steaming bowl of pasta.
entries.zh: 厨师把一颗松露刨成薄片，撒在热气腾腾的意面上。

entries.en: Holidaymakers gathered on the pier to watch the evening ferry arrive.
entries.zh: 度假者们聚在码头上，看晚班渡轮进港。

entries.en: A narrow frill edged the collar of the child's costume.
entries.zh: 那件儿童戏服的领口饰着一圈窄褶边。

entries.en: The lecture explored romanticism through paintings of dramatic mountain landscapes.
entries.zh: 讲座通过描绘壮阔山景的画作探讨了浪漫主义。

entries.en: He became possessive about the shared studio and resented other visitors.
entries.zh: 他对共用工作室产生了强烈的占有欲，不愿让其他人来访。

entries.en: The charming sketch differed sharply from the actuality of the cramped room.
entries.zh: 那幅迷人的草图与房间实际上狭窄的状况大不相同。

entries.en: The wildlife film shows how the animals mark territory when they urinate.
entries.zh: 这部野生动物影片展示了动物排尿时如何标记领地。

entries.en: A blue rosette decorated the winning pony's bridle.
entries.zh: 获胜小马的笼头上装饰着一朵蓝色玫瑰花形饰物。

entries.en: The little building is popularly known as the crooked house.
entries.zh: 那座小建筑被大家称作歪房子。

entries.en: She found the missing spanner beneath a roll of canvas.
entries.zh: 她在一卷帆布下面找到了丢失的扳手。

entries.en: The costume archive keeps delicate lingerie in flat, labelled boxes.
entries.zh: 服装档案馆把精细的女式内衣放在贴有标签的扁盒里。

entries.en: The unfamiliar music challenged my preconceptions about the instrument.
entries.zh: 这种陌生的音乐挑战了我对那件乐器的先入之见。

entries.en: The gallery's sudden closure caused a furore among local artists.
entries.zh: 画廊突然关闭，在当地艺术家中引起了轩然大波。

entries.en: The old fisherman bemoaned the disappearance of the wooden harbour steps.
entries.zh: 那位老渔夫哀叹港口木台阶的消失。

entries.en: Peppermint grew in a pot outside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 厨房窗外的一只花盆里长着胡椒薄荷。

entries.en: A bogey on the final hole ended her hopes of winning.
entries.zh: 最后一洞高于标准杆一杆，使她失去了获胜的希望。

entries.meaningZh: 对同性恋的偏见或敌意
entries.en: The film challenges homophobia through a story of friendship and courage.
entries.zh: 这部电影通过一个关于友谊与勇气的故事反对恐同偏见。

entries.en: Her bubbly personality made the long coach journey feel shorter.
entries.zh: 她活泼开朗的性格让漫长的长途汽车旅程显得短了些。

entries.en: The cabinet's hidden joints revealed the maker's exceptional craftsmanship.
entries.zh: 柜子隐藏的接合处体现了制作者非凡的工艺。

entries.en: The dinner menu paired the mushroom pie with a glass of claret.
entries.zh: 晚餐菜单为蘑菇派搭配了一杯波尔多红葡萄酒。

entries.en: An owl hooted from the oak beyond the campsite.
entries.zh: 营地外的橡树上传来一只猫头鹰的叫声。

entries.en: He spluttered an apology when the paint landed on her shoes.
entries.zh: 颜料落在她的鞋上时，他急促而慌乱地道了歉。

entries.en: She balanced a heavy tome on the narrow library desk.
entries.zh: 她把一本厚重的大部头书放稳在狭窄的图书馆书桌上。

entries.en: The exhibition links Renaissance humanism with new approaches to portrait painting.
entries.zh: 展览将文艺复兴时期的人文主义与肖像画的新手法联系起来。

entries.en: The enlarged photograph shows a louse beside a strand of hair.
entries.zh: 放大的照片显示，一只虱子在一根头发旁边。

entries.en: The biology diagram traces the development of a mammalian foetus.
entries.zh: 这幅生物学图解描绘了哺乳动物胎儿的发育过程。

entries.en: The historical painting depicts the scene where the prisoners were crucified.
entries.zh: 这幅历史画描绘了囚犯被钉死在十字架上的场景。

entries.en: The museum welcomed its hundredth visitor before the morning tour ended.
entries.zh: 上午的导览结束前，博物馆迎来了第一百位访客。

entries.en: A white poodle waited beside the florist's delivery bicycle.
entries.zh: 一只白色贵宾犬等在花店的送货自行车旁。

entries.en: The old medical atlas includes a labelled drawing of a cyst.
entries.zh: 那本旧医学图谱收录了一幅标明名称的囊肿图。

entries.en: The portrait faithfully records a small wart on the sitter's chin.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像如实画出了被画者下巴上的一颗小疣。

entries.en: The essay criticizes consumerism through the endless advertising in the city.
entries.zh: 这篇文章通过城市里无休止的广告批判消费主义。

entries.en: The unimpressed judge asked for evidence rather than another elaborate explanation.
entries.zh: 那位不以为然的评委要的是证据，而不是又一番复杂的解释。

entries.en: The detective noticed the phoney signature at the bottom of the letter.
entries.zh: 侦探注意到了信件底部伪造的签名。

entries.en: The research vessel stopped at a small harbour to refuel.
entries.zh: 那艘考察船停靠一个小港口补充燃料。

entries.en: The workshop retrained former printers to repair vintage cameras.
entries.zh: 这家工坊重新培训了以前的印刷工，让他们修理老式相机。

entries.en: The story's lovable bear never remembers where he leaves his spectacles.
entries.zh: 故事里那只可爱的熊总不记得自己把眼镜放在哪里。

entries.en: We took a bus uptown to visit her pottery studio.
entries.zh: 我们坐公交车到住宅区去参观她的陶艺工作室。

entries.en: The puppet's jerky movements made the audience laugh.
entries.zh: 木偶不平稳的动作逗笑了观众。

entries.en: The sailors unfurled a bright flag as the harbour came into view.
entries.zh: 港口进入视野时，水手们展开了一面鲜艳的旗帜。

entries.en: A retired warplane stands outside the aviation museum.
entries.zh: 一架退役的军用飞机停放在航空博物馆外。

entries.en: The psychology lecture examined public misconceptions about hypnosis.
entries.zh: 心理学讲座探讨了公众对催眠的误解。

entries.en: An intolerant chairperson dismissed every suggestion that differed from his own.
entries.zh: 那位不容异见的主席驳回了所有与自己意见不同的建议。

entries.en: The medical history exhibit includes an early poster about measles.
entries.zh: 医学史展览收录了一张早期关于麻疹的海报。

entries.en: The café served chocolate mousse in small blue bowls.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆用蓝色小碗盛着巧克力慕斯。

entries.en: The quiet caretaker masterminded the surprise exhibition in the station hall.
entries.zh: 那位沉默的管理员策划了车站大厅里的惊喜展览。

entries.en: The novel explores an implacable hatred between two neighbouring families.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了两个邻居家庭之间无法消除的仇恨。

entries.en: A brief stoppage in the rehearsal allowed us to reset the scenery.
entries.zh: 排练短暂中断，让我们得以重新布置场景。

entries.en: A perfectionist, she repainted the tiny door until its colour matched exactly.
entries.zh: 她是个完美主义者，一遍遍重涂那扇小门，直到颜色完全相配。

entries.en: The regimental band performed beneath the town hall's open windows.
entries.zh: 那个团的军乐队在市政厅敞开的窗下演奏。

entries.en: Her long skirt swished across the polished dance floor.
entries.zh: 她的长裙掠过光亮的舞池地面，发出轻轻的嗖嗖声。

entries.en: We nabbed the last two seats beside the open window.
entries.zh: 我们抢先占到了敞开的窗边最后两个座位。
